acadia.d: Beehive Trail (out and back, about 1.5 miles with iron rungs, steep, Jun-Oct); Jordan Pond Path (loop, about 3.3 miles, easy, May-Oct); Cadillac North Ridge Trail (walk-up summit, about 4.4 miles round trip, steep, May-Oct)
acadia.st: Cliff trails closed from 1 March 2026 until further notice to protect nesting peregrine falcons: Jordan Cliffs, Penobscot East, Precipice and Valley Cove (NPS news release, 2 Mar 2026); the annual closure usually lifts in summer. Beehive was not listed. Park Loop Road is closed to cars about 1 Dec to mid-April.

algarve.d: Seven Hanging Valleys (point to point, about 4 to 7 miles one way depending on the end point, steady, Feb-Nov); Ponta da Piedade cliff walk (out and back, about 1 mile, easy, year-round)
algarve.m: Fishermen's Trail (11-13 days, about 140 miles, guesthouses, trek, Feb-May and Oct-Nov); Via Algarviana (14 stages, about 186 miles, guesthouses, trek, Feb-May and Oct-Nov)

amalfi.d: Path of the Gods (point to point, about 4 to 5 miles from Bomerano to Nocelle, steady, Mar-Nov); Valle delle Ferriere (out and back, short waterfall walk, easy, year-round)

amsterdam.d: Zuid-Kennemerland National Park dune paths (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, easy, year-round)

andalucia.d: Caminito del Rey (point to point, about 5 miles, easy, Mar-Nov); Mulhacén from Capileira (walk-up summit, about 12 to 17 miles round trip, strenuous, Jun-Oct); Los Cahorros de Monachil (loop, about 5 miles, steady, Mar-Nov)
andalucia.m: Sulayr GR 240 around the Sierra Nevada (about 19 stages, villages and refuges, trek, Jun-Oct)

angkor.d: Chi Phat day treks in the Cardamom Mountains (guided jungle and waterfall loops, easy to steady, Nov-Feb)
angkor.m: Chi Phat Cardamom treks (about 2 to 4 days, guided, hammock camping, trek, Nov-Feb); Virachey National Park treks (guided, camping, trek, Nov-Feb)

antarctica.d: Shore landings from Zodiacs (short guided walks beside penguin colonies, easy, Nov-Mar)

arches-canyonlands.d: Delicate Arch (out and back, about 3 miles, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Devils Garden Primitive Loop (loop, about 7 miles with scrambling, steep, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Chesler Park in the Needles (loop, about 6 to 11 miles, steady to steep, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
arches-canyonlands.m: Needles district backpacking loops (2 to 3 days, camping with permits, trek, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
arches-canyonlands.st: Timed-entry reservations were not required at Arches in 2026 (NPS announcement, 18 Feb 2026); the system ran 2022 to 2025 and could return. Fiery Furnace still needs its own permit.

argentine-lake-district.d: Refugio Frey (out and back, about 12 miles round trip from Cerro Catedral, steep, Dec-Mar and the hut is open year-round)
argentine-lake-district.m: Nahuel Huapi traverse (3 to 5 days, about 29 miles, mountain huts or camping, trek, Dec-Mar)

aruba.d: Seroe Jamanota (walk-up summit, short climb of 700 or more steps, easy, Dec-Apr); Arikok National Park coastal trails (loop, about 2 to 4 miles, easy, Dec-Apr)

aspen.d: Maroon Lake Scenic Trail to Crater Lake (out and back, about 3.6 miles, easy, Jul-Sep); Cathedral Lake (out and back, about 5.5 miles, steep, Jul-Sep)
aspen.m: Four Pass Loop (3 to 4 days, about 26 miles, camping, strenuous trek, Jul-Sep); Conundrum Hot Springs (2 days, about 17 miles round trip, camping, trek, Jul-Sep)

atacama.d: Valle de la Luna dune ridge walk (out and back, about 2 miles, easy, year-round); Quebrada de Guatín (out and back through a cactus canyon, steady, year-round)

athens.d: Mount Parnitha to the Bafi refuge (loop, about 5 to 8 miles, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Mount Hymettus ridge (out and back, about 4 to 6 miles, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
athens.st: Greek authorities ban entry to forests and national parks on high fire-risk days in summer, which closes Parnitha and Hymettus trails at short notice.

azores.d: Mount Pico (walk-up summit, about 5 miles round trip with about 3,600 feet of climbing, strenuous, Jun-Sep); Sete Cidades crater rim (loop, about 7 miles, steady, year-round); Faial Caldeira rim (loop, about 4 miles, steady, year-round)

badlands-black-hills.d: Notch Trail (out and back, about 1.5 miles with a log ladder, steady, Apr-Oct); Castle Trail (out and back, about 10 miles, steady, Apr-Oct); Black Elk Peak by Trail 9 (walk-up summit, about 7 miles round trip, steady, May-Oct)
badlands-black-hills.m: Centennial Trail (about 111 miles, camping, trek, May-Oct)

bagan.d: Hsipaw hill and village hikes (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Nov-Feb); Kalaw village hikes (loop, about 5 to 8 miles, easy to steady, Nov-Feb)
bagan.m: Kalaw to Inle Lake (2 to 3 days, about 35 miles, village homestays, trek, Nov-Feb); Mount Victoria, Nat Ma Taung (2 to 3 days, guided, village and camp, trek, Nov-Mar)

bahamas.d: Lucayan National Park boardwalks (loop, about 1 mile, easy, Nov-Apr)

bali.d: Mount Batur sunrise trek (walk-up summit, about 2 hours up, steady, Apr-Oct; guide required); Campuhan Ridge Walk (out and back, about 1.5 miles, easy, year-round)

banff.d: Plain of Six Glaciers (out and back, about 8.5 miles, steady, Jul-Sep); Larch Valley and Sentinel Pass (out and back, about 7 miles, steep, Jul-Sep; larches turn late September); Johnston Canyon to the Upper Falls (out and back, about 3.5 miles, easy, year-round)
banff.m: Skyline Trail in Jasper (3 days, about 27 miles, backcountry campgrounds, trek, Jul-Sep)
banff.st: Jasper wildfire recovery: a Parks Canada bulletin effective 26 Jun to 14 Aug 2026 closed Edith Cavell Road and its trails (Path of the Glacier, Cavell Meadows) and Maligne Canyon trails; most other Jasper trails have reopened since the 2024 fire. A 2026 status for the Skyline Trail was not found.

bangkok.d: Lumphini Park paths (loop, about 1.5 miles, easy, Nov-Feb); Bang Krachao elevated paths (loop, about 2 to 5 miles, easy, Nov-Feb)

barbados.d: Bath to Bathsheba coastal path (point to point, easy, Dec-Apr)

barcelona.d: Montserrat to Sant Jeroni (out and back, about 6 miles, steep, Oct-May); Collserola ridge trails (loop, about 4 to 8 miles, easy to steady, year-round)

basque-country.d: Zumaia to Deba flysch coast (point to point, about 9 miles, steady, Mar-Nov); San Juan de Gaztelugatxe (out and back, about 1.5 miles with 241 steps, easy, Mar-Nov); Mount Gorbea (walk-up summit, about 6 to 8 miles round trip, steady, Apr-Nov)
basque-country.m: Camino del Norte through the Basque coast (about 6 to 7 days, about 110 miles, guesthouses, trek, Apr-Oct)

bavaria-munich.d: Eibsee lake loop (loop, about 4.5 miles, easy, May-Oct); Partnachklamm gorge (out and back, about 2 miles, easy, year-round)
bavaria-munich.m: Zugspitze by the Reintal (2 days, about 13 miles, mountain hut, strenuous, Jul-Sep)

beijing.d: Mutianyu Great Wall (out and back, about 3 miles with stairs, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Jinshanling Great Wall (point to point, about 4 to 6 miles of restored and unrestored wall, steady, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Jiankou to Mutianyu (point to point, about 4 miles of unrestored wall, steep, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
beijing.st: Sources conflict on whether the Simatai West to Jinshanling through-hike is open since renovations; operators say the Jinshanling east gate closes in winter (about 15 Nov to 15 Mar) and Jiankou is sometimes closed for fire prevention. Check the ticketing site before booking.

belfast-giants-causeway.d: Giant's Causeway cliff path (out and back, about 3 to 5 miles, easy, year-round); Slieve Donard (walk-up summit, about 6 miles round trip, steep, May-Oct); Glenariff Forest Park waterfall trail (loop, about 3 miles, easy, year-round)
belfast-giants-causeway.m: Causeway Coast Way (2 to 3 days, about 33 miles, guesthouses, trek, Apr-Oct); Mourne Way (2 to 3 days, about 26 miles, guesthouses, trek, Apr-Oct)

belize.d: Tiger Fern Trail in Cockscomb Basin (out and back, about 2 miles, steady, Nov-May); Antelope Falls at Mayflower Bocawina (out and back, about 3 miles with a rope-assisted climb, steep, Nov-May)

bend-crater-lake.d: South Sister (walk-up summit, about 12 miles round trip, strenuous, Jul-Sep); Garfield Peak at Crater Lake (out and back, about 3.4 miles, steady, Jul-Oct); Cleetwood Cove Trail (out and back, about 2.2 miles, steep, Jul-Sep)
bend-crater-lake.m: Three Sisters Loop (2 to 3 days, about 45 to 50 miles, camping, trek, Jul-Sep)

berlin.d: Grunewald forest and Havel shore (loop, about 5 to 8 miles, easy, year-round)

bhutan.d: Tiger's Nest, Paro Taktsang (out and back, about 5 hours round trip, steep, Mar-May and Sep-Nov); Gangtey Nature Trail in the Phobjikha valley (loop, about 3 miles, easy, Mar-May and Sep-Nov)
bhutan.m: Druk Path Trek (about 6 trekking days, camping, trek, Mar-May and Oct-Nov); Snowman Trek (about 24 trekking days, camping, expedition trek, Sep-Oct)

big-island.d: Kilauea Iki Trail (loop, about 4 miles, steady, year-round); Devastation Trail (out and back, about 1 mile, easy, year-round); Pololu Valley Trail (out and back, short and steep, year-round)
big-island.st: Hiking down Waipio Valley is prohibited under a Hawaii County emergency rule in place since 2022 and renewed about every 60 days; the only legal visitor entry is a permitted shuttle tour, and the rim lookout is open. Reported renewal through 1 Nov 2026, not confirmed with the county.

black-forest.d: Wutach Gorge (point to point, about 9 miles, steady, Apr-Oct); Feldberg summit (walk-up summit, steady, May-Oct); Triberg Waterfalls (loop, short, easy, year-round)
black-forest.m: Westweg (12 to 14 days, about 177 miles, guesthouses, trek, May-Oct); Schluchtensteig (6 stages, about 74 miles, guesthouses, trek, May-Oct)

borabora.d: Mount Pahia (walk-up summit, guide required, steep, Apr-Oct); Mount Otemanu shoulder (out and back, steep, Apr-Oct)

bordeaux.d: Saint-Emilion vineyard loops (loop, about 3 to 6 miles, easy, Mar-Nov); Arcachon Bay and Dune du Pilat paths (loop, about 3 to 5 miles, easy, Mar-Nov)

borneo.d: Bako National Park jungle and coastal loops (loop, about 2 to 8 miles, easy to steady, year-round); Danum Valley guided rainforest walks (guided, easy to steady, Mar-Oct)
borneo.m: Mount Kinabalu summit trail (2 days, about 5.4 miles each way, mountain hut at Panalaban, strenuous trek, Mar-Oct)

botswana.d: Guided bush walks on Okavango islands (guided, easy, May-Oct)

budapest.d: Normafa to Janos Hill lookout (out and back, short, easy, year-round)

buenosaires.d: Reserva Ecologica Costanera Sur (loop, about 3 miles, easy, year-round); Tigre delta paths (loop, easy, year-round)
